voice.register: Sharp and witty — but dry, never zany.
voice.principle: Warm and whimsical, but never too poetic — copy must always paint a clear picture of what we do as a business.
rules: Wit is a scalpel: one clever turn per piece, maximum.
Confidence, no hype: no exclamation marks, no 'revolutionary'. State it plainly and let the bulb glow.
The 1/8th principle: show the one lit idea; never list every venture.
Volume is set per division: Ideas loudest, Publications & Productions measured, Aubrey North quietest.

taglines.note: Hero is primary and always available. Short form is the compact, evocative sibling for tight spaces (sign-offs, social, app splash) — never a replacement for the hero. Descriptor sits under either to keep the meaning clear.
